title: Ganga Ashtakam
intro: Ganga Ashtakam is a sacred hymn praising Goddess Ganga. Read the complete lyrics, meaning, and benefits of Ganga Ashtakam.
description:
|| Shri Gangashtakam ||

bhagavati tava tire neeramatrashanoham
vigatavishayatrishnah krishnamaradhayami |
sakalakalushabhange svargasopanasange
taralataratarange devi gange prasida ||1||

bhagavati bhavlilamaulimale tavambhah
kanamanuparimanam pranino ye sprshanti |
amaranagaranarichamragrahininam
vigatakalakalankatankamanke luthanti ||2||

brahmandam khandayanti harashirasi jatavallimullasayanti
svarlokadapatanti kanakagiriguhagandashalatskhalanti |
shoniprishte luthanti duritachayachamunirbharam bhartsayanti
pathodhim purayanti suranagarsaritpavani nah punatu ||3||

majjanmatangakumbhachyutamadamadiramodamattalijalam
snanaih siddhangananam kuchayugavigalatkunkumasangapingam |
sayampratamuninam kushakusumachayayshchannatirasthaniram
payanno gangamambhah karikalabhakarakrantaramhastarangam ||4||

adavadipitamahasya niyamavyaparapatre jalam
pashatpannagashayino bhagavatah padodakam pavanam |
bhuyah shambhujatavibhushanamanirjahnormaharsheriyam
kanya kalmashanashini bhagavati bhagirathi drshyate ||5||

shailendradavatarini nijajale majjajjanottarini
paravaraviharini bhavabhayashrenisamutsarini |
sheshaheranukarini harashirovallidalakarini
kashiprantaviharini vijayate ganga manoharini ||6||

kuto vichirvichistava yadi gata lochanapatham
tvamapita pitambarapuranivasam vitarasi |
tvadutsange gange patati yadi kayastanubhratam
tada mata shatakratavapadalabhoopyatilaghuh ||7||

gange trailokyasare sakalasuravadhudhoutavistirnatoye
purnabrahmasvarupe haricharanarajoharini svargamarge |
prayashchittam yadi syattava jalakanika brahmahatyadipape
kastvam stotum samarthastrijagadaghahare devi gange prasida ||8||

matarjahnavi shambhusamgalite maulau nidhayanjalim
tvattire vapushoavsanasamaye narayananghridvayam |
sanandam smarato bhavishyati mama pranaprayanotsave
bhuyadbhaktiravichyutahariharadvaitatmika shashvati ||9||

gangashtakamidam punyam yah pathetprayato narah |
sarvapapavinirmukto vishnulokam sa gachchhati ||10||

|| Iti Shri Shankaracharya Virachitam Shri Gangashtakam Sampurnam ||

faq.a1: Shri Gangashtakam was composed by the great saint and founder of Advaita Vedanta, Adi Guru Shankaracharya.
faq.q2: What is the main significance and purpose of Gangashtakam?
faq.a2: This stotra praises the divine and sacred form of Mother Ganga, her flow, and the liberation attained at her banks. Its purpose is to express deep devotion and surrender towards Mother Ganga.
faq.q3: How many verses are there in Gangashtakam?
faq.a3: Shri Gangashtakam contains a total of 10 verses, consisting of 9 verses of praise (stuti) and 1 verse detailing its benefits (phalashruti).
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Gangashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular and sincere recitation frees a person from all sins. According to the phalashruti, the person who recites it attains Vishnulok (the abode of Lord Vishnu).
faq.a5: It can be recited daily in the morning during bath or daily worship. Reciting it on the banks of the Ganges, on Ganga Dussehra, and on Purnima (full moon days) is considered especially auspicious.
